notes: Task, fine-tuning and IDE states preserve WAITING as stopped or not yet started and FAULT_SCHEDULING as recovery.
Dataset export is asynchronous: the mutation is never retried or polled. The separate canDownload detail command supplies download readiness.
Resource quotas and workspace usage queries do not expose resource lifecycle state enums.

request_notes: Published wildcard paths are bound to declared positional arguments without duplicate CLI options. GET start/stop, dataset publication/export and directory creation remain confirmed mutations.

Dataset upload accepts one local file per invocation as the documented multipart file field. The upstream note permits up to 100 files, but repeated multipart parts are not represented by the current metadata model.

Personal storage import lists File under query parameters but explicitly demonstrates curl -F file=@... and multipart/form-data. Preserve scalar region/cluster/path query fields and put the binary file in its documented multipart form part.
EOP signature, timestamp and request ID are supplied by the core signer; the misspelled ctyum-eop-request-id table entry is not a separate user input.
endpoint_notes: Self-operated customer APIs under the listed huiju, aipaas and modelService prefixes. The endpoint table is empty; 61 captured examples use huijuaip-global.ctapi.ctyun.cn. Eight request examples use ctap rather than ctapi in the hostname; the majority spelling is used without inventing another endpoint.
response_notes: Published successful responses use statusCode 200 alongside error AIP_40000000; the error string alone is not a failure. Multipart uploads additionally require the documented true result.

Dataset export starts an asynchronous task and returns a JSON acknowledgement with mutation confirmation. The separate download URL query (API 16968) only retrieves the link according to its functional description, so it is a retryable retrieval with no mutation prompt; its JSON string is not binary response content.
